effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T05b of the step "Compare Mac heavy, moderate and idle operating conditions". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent + 1.5 hours owner; three runs under owner-set conditions (office, home, overnight), spread over days. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 1.5 h → 1 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (1 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
